sections.title: Customer Data Handling
sections.content: Agents must not request or disclose full payment card numbers, CVV, passwords, or government IDs via chat/email. Only last 4 digits may be used for verification. Sensitive verification must use secure portal or phone.

sections.title: Identity Verification
sections.content: For account access requests, verify identity via OTP to registered email/phone or security questions. Do not bypass verification even if customer claims urgency. Escalate to Security if account takeover suspected.

sections.title: Fraud Handling
sections.content: Suspected fraud or unauthorized access must be escalated immediately to Fraud/Security team. Agent must not promise resolution; must lock account temporarily and provide incident reference.
